scheme_name: Providing Tin stalls to Gatai Kamgar
other_conditions: Must be a resident of Maharashtra.
If residing in a rural area, total household income must be less than ₹40,000.
If residing in an urban area, total household income must be less than ₹50,000.
Stall location must be on rent/lease/purchased/official free hand by Gram Panchayat, Municipality, Cantonment Board, Municipal corporation, or on the applicant's own property.
benefits_summary: Provides a 100% government‑funded tin stall and a ₹500 financial assistance to eligible applicants.
